title: Past Time Expressions and Story Sequencing
main_grammar: marcadores temporais e organização de narrativas no pretérito perfeito.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Sequence a busy day you had” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Time markers first, then, later and finally organize completed past events.
student.structure: primeiro + past; depois + past; por fim + past
student.english_comparison: English time adverbs work similarly; the action remains past in Portuguese.

useful_words.example: Antes de sair, falei com ela.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “Later, I ate rice.”?
Which sentence expresses “Then I went home.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Ontem eu tive um dia cheio. Primeiro, trabalhei em casa. Depois, estudei português. Mais tarde, fui ao mercado. Antes de sair, falei com minha irmã. Então, preparei o jantar. Por fim, descansei e li um livro.
questions: O que o narrador fez primeiro?
O que ele fez por fim?
O que você fez primeiro ontem?
O que você fez por fim?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Give the listener a timeline with no unnecessary tense switching.

examples.pt: Antes de sair, falei com ela.
examples.en: Before leaving, I spoke to her.

review.compare: Antes de sair / Depois de chegar: before and after use infinitives.

common_mistakes.explanation: Keep both yesterday events in the past.
Depois de prepositions, use an infinitive.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: Before leaving, I spoke to her.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: Before leaving, I spoke to her.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

Por fim, descansei. ________, fui para casa.
Antes de sair, falei com ela. ________ fim, descansei.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: No sábado, Ana visitou os pais. Primeiro, comprou um presente. Depois, foi para a casa deles. Mais tarde, todos almoçaram juntos. Antes de voltar, Ana ajudou na cozinha. Por fim, ela chegou em casa e descansou.
questions: O que Ana fez antes de voltar?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 80–120 words on the topic “Sequence a busy day you had”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — O que você fez primeiro ontem? / O que você fez depois? / O que você fez por fim? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Keep clear pauses after primeiro and por fim.

F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
